ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity dark pixels across >90% of visible fluke surface; high-intensity white/grey pixels restricted to localized scarring and highlight streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous dark pigmentation base; contiguous high-contrast linear streaks located in the upper-right quadrant of the left lobe and mid-section of the right lobe; distinct high-intensity circular ring outlines clustered on the lower right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central depression; estimated internal angle of 145-155 degrees; apex is distinct and well-defined.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations; pixel amplitude variations range from 3-12 pixels along the continuous trailing boundary; notable jagged peaks on the lateral sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature from notch to tip; terminal ends of lobes are tapered and exhibit a slight posterior-facing sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-contrast rings (approx. 8-15 pixel diameter) detected; cluster of three rings in a triangular configuration on the lower-right lobe; single rings scattered on the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned white linear pixel disruptions; prominent 45-degree diagonal scratch on the upper left lobe; multiple horizontal scratches on the right lobe interior.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring (consistent with cookie-cutter shark or lamprey marks) and multi-directional rake marks across both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique triplet cluster of circular ring scars on the posterior section of the right lobe.
